set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/peft/tuners/lora/dora.py")
source = path.read_text()
assert source.count('@cache_decorator("weight-norm")') == 2, "Expected GOLD caching decorators"
anchors = ['        weight_norm = torch.linalg.norm(weight, dim=1).to(weight.dtype)\n        return weight_norm\n', '        weight_norm = weight.norm(p=2, dim=dim, keepdim=True).transpose(1, 0)\n        return weight_norm\n']
for anchor in anchors:
    assert source.count(anchor) == 1, "Expected exactly one GOLD norm anchor: " + repr(anchor)
    replacement = anchor.replace("return weight_norm", "return torch.ones_like(weight_norm)")
    source = source.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
assert source.count("return torch.ones_like(weight_norm)") == 2
path.write_text(source)
PY

_check_common.text:
def _check_common(observed, key):
    r = observed[key]
    assert r["num_caches"] >= 1
    # before any caching was ever engaged, all dora caches must be empty
    assert all(v is False for v in r["caches_empty_before_any_caching"])
    # DoRA must actually change the output relative to the un-adapted base model
    assert r["base_vs_dora_differ"] is True

test_dora_caching_linear_matches_uncache.text:
def test_dora_caching_linear_matches_uncached_result(observed):
    r = observed["linear"]
    _check_common(observed, "linear")
    dora = np.array(r["dora_result"])
    c1 = np.array(r["cached_result_1"])
    c2 = np.array(r["cached_result_2"])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(c1, dora, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(c2, dora, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

test_cache_populated_while_context_activ.text:
def test_cache_populated_while_context_active(observed, key):
    r = observed[key]
    # after the very first forward call inside the caching context, all dora
    # caches for this model must be populated
    assert all(v is True for v in r["caches_nonempty_after_first_cached_call"])

test_cache_cleared_after_context_exit.text:
def test_cache_cleared_after_context_exit(observed, key):
    r = observed[key]
    # the forward call performed after exiting the `with DoraCaching()` block
    # must not use stale cached values (caching disabled again by then)
    assert all(v is False for v in r["caches_nonempty_after_exit_forward"])
    dora = np.array(r["dora_result"])
    after_exit = np.array(r["after_exit_result"])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(after_exit, dora, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

test_train_mode_disables_and_clears_cach.text:
def test_train_mode_disables_and_clears_cache(observed, key):
    r = observed[key]
    # switching the model to train() must clear any lingering cache immediately
    assert all(v is False for v in r["caches_nonempty_after_train_switch"])
    # even with the global caching flag enabled (inside the `with` block), a
    # module in training mode must never populate its cache
    assert all(v is False for v in r["caches_nonempty_during_train_forward"])
    dora = np.array(r["dora_result"])
    train_mode = np.array(r["train_mode_result"])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(train_mode, dora, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

test_permanent_toggle_matches_context_ma.text:
def test_permanent_toggle_matches_context_manager_semantics(observed, key):
    r = observed[key]
    dora = np.array(r["dora_result"])
    perm = np.array(r["perm_cached_result"])
    # DoraCaching()(enabled=True) permanently enables caching outside of a
    # `with` block, but must still preserve the numerical result
    np.testing.assert_allclose(perm, dora, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
